propositions: The query ticket digest is re-sent in full on every overlap judge call despite being identical across a batch, occupying the volatile user message block which cannot be cached
Moving the invariant query digest from the user message into the system prompt places it in the cacheable stable prefix, enabling the cache machinery already configured at this call site

The implementation adds a keyword-only shared_side argument to judge_one, hoists the query digest into the system prompt via a module-private helper, and substitutes a reference string into the vacated slot
Measured system+query-digest prefix is 846 tokens, below the measured 1024-token floor for claude-sonnet-4-6, resulting in +936 token regression (cache read/write remains zero)
Judgement precision is preserved: all 12 ordered pairs show identical relation verdicts across baseline and hoisted implementations with confidences within sampling variance
